newsitem.title: USA: Mass. tax revs up last half of '96 - report.
newsitem.headline: Mass. tax revs up last half of '96 - report.

text.p: Massachusetts collected about $5.8 billion in taxes from July through December, up 7.8 percent from the same period last year, the Boston Globe reported Wednesday.
According to Massachusetts Department of Revenue figures, sales tax receipts were up 13.2 percent, led by strong car and home sales, the Globe said.

Net income tax receipts totalled $3.19 billion compared to $2.97 billion the previous year, sales and use taxes rose to $1.44 billion from $1.27 billion and corporate taxes rose to $335 million from $327 million, the Globe said.
Business excise taxes for the six month period rose slightly to $193 million from $190 million and other excise taxes rose to $648 million from $622 million, the newspaper said.
